【原视频简介】
MiniMax-H3 just got another acceleration option! In this video, we're
testing the new 8-step PDD (Parallel Decoding Distillation) LoRA from
Alibaba PAI for MiniMax-H3 in ComfyUI.

𝐓𝐨 𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐏𝐃𝐃 𝐋𝐨𝐑𝐀𝐬, 𝐲𝐨𝐮'𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐮𝐩𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐟𝐲𝐔𝐈 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐥𝐲 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝, 𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐑𝐀𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐲𝐞𝐭 𝐚𝐯𝐚𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝟎.𝟑𝟒.𝟎 𝐫𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞.

In the previous video, we tested a 4-step Turbo LoRA for MiniMax-H3.
This time, we're trying a different acceleration approach based on
Parallel Decoding Distillation, designed to generate multiple
denoising steps per network evaluation.

We put the PDD LoRA through several real-world tests and compare it
against both the original 20-step MiniMax-H3 model and the 8-step Turbo
LoRA.

### What We Test

-   MiniMax-H3 Original vs PDD vs Turbo
-   8-step PDD video generation
-   FL2VA workflow in ComfyUI
-   Ref2VA workflow in ComfyUI
-   Cinematic facial detail and subtle motion
-   Complex transformation and dynamic motion
-   First-person motorcycle footage
-   Multi-character identity consistency
-   Ref2VA character generation
-   Motion and temporal consistency
-   Audio generation and synchronization
-   Quality…
